title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Assalaam-ale-kum, Jazaakaallah for this online services. May Allah reward you all for this help in duniya as well as in akhirat. I was 30 when I got married 3 years back without the consent of my parents through matrimonial site, due to their rejection of my marriage at that time. I was wandering away from my home and city for 7 years for jobs as my parents wanted me to settle with high income job.During these years I kept minimum amount for food and stayed in masjid's accomodation to send maximum money to my parents. I became home sick and family sick during these years but tried to sustain my life anyhow. But after a certain extend it was impossible for me to live isolated so I married. As according to Hdeeth-(As for the person who has a very urgent need, nikah will be fard upon him. This is because there is a fear that he will commit adultery and thereby get the sin of committing a haram act) Even after my marriage I was fulfilling my duty as a son -Financially, morally and in every aspect. I kept my personal married life a low affair- financially as well as other matter, no extravagant expenses.Still my parents are not happy with me and asking me to get married according to their wishes or cut off from the family. Please advise me what I should do? Please answer what I did is right or wrong according to Shariah? 2708 views Q. I am 28 years old male. My marriage is very soon. My question is that can I use any engagement (like ring, nose pin, etc.) 3164 views Q. I would like to ask can we do NIKAH and VALIMA same day.(i.e Nikah at Asr and followed by VALIMA)? Or we need to do Nikah first and the next day we have to do VALIMA? Here lot of people are doing this so. 7890 views Q. nikah of shia and sunni 29735 views Q. Am I mahram or non-mahram to my foster son’s wife? 3152 views Q. ASAK. Main yeh poochna chahta hoon ke "agar ek ladka ladki ek doosre ko pasand karte hain aur ek doosre se yeh kehden ke main apne dil se tumhe biwi manta hoon ya ladki kehde ke main tumhe shauhar maanti hoon" aur "agar phone mien bhi ye iqraar ho ke main allah aur uske farishton ko gawah bana kar main tumse nikah karta hoon aur ladki ya ladkha yeh kehde mujhe qubool hai teen martaba, kahen" to kya nikah hojata hai. Badi saqt zaroorat thi, allah jaza-e-qair de agar mujhe jald-az-jald jawab miljaye. Aise haalat yahan par bahut ho rahe hain. Bahut hi mehebaani hogi. Asak. Jazakallah! 24672 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 35460 Country: India Title: We wish to know any authentic hadith, sahaba's amal or tab'een's amal regarding mahr mu'ajjal whether it will be paid after having performed marital course (Jima) Question: We wish to know any authentic hadith, sahaba's amal or tab'een's amal regarding mahr mu'ajjal whether it will be paid after having performed marital course (Jima). You will co-operate us in removing our doubt. May Allah bless you! Your quick response will be highly appreciated. Answer ID: 35460 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2038/1641/B=1432) Mahr that is paid before intercourse is called mahr mu’ajjal as per the Fiqh scholars. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
